header.name: PatrixWorld Sampler [BARKFIX v0.2.3]
header.description: v0.2.3 BARKFIX — load warnings and missing textures. (1) Fixed blocks.json format_version 1.21.120→1.1.0 (prior session wrongly bumped it thinking that enabled variations — max for blocks.json is 1.1.0, and 1.21.120 was being silently downgraded to 1.1.0, causing some entries to not fully parse). (2) Fixed muddy_mangrove_roots entry — was missing 'down' face, now complete. (3) Fixed the purple/black missing-texture issue on dirt sides exposed when breaking grass_block: shortname 'grass_block_side' wasn't registered (Patrix uses legacy 'grass_side'); added alias. (4) Added podzol (textures + shortnames + blocks.json entry). (5) Auto-registered sandstone_normal + red_sandstone_normal side shortnames that were referenced but missing. (6) Ported Patrix log/plank/leaves textures for all 10 wood species (oak/spruce/birch/jungle/acacia/dark_oak/mangrove/cherry/crimson/warped) — 58 new PNGs. This fixes the bark color mismatch between standing trees (was vanilla) and BIGCANOPY falling entity (Patrix-colored) — now both match. Added 24 legacy shortname aliases (log_oak, log_big_oak, leaves_jungle etc.) for full Bedrock compat. Carries v0.2.2 VARFIX + v0.2.1 SMOOTH + v0.1.9 MYCOPORT.
